verdict.rationale: Expensify's app source is publicly readable on GitHub (github.com/Expensify/App), with build instructions (`npm install`, `npm run web`), so a user can read and run the client code. The evidence never states which license applies, so the 'open license' part of the story is unconfirmed. missing for 10: evidence of an OSI/open-source license on the repo, confirmation of scope (backend/server code vs. client app only), independent corroboration of openness.
